name: Hakui (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Hakui city emblem in white: a ring with four pointed spokes enclosing a stylised letter Y with a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Hakui, a city in Ishikawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 30 September 1958.

features.role: Hakui city emblem — a ring with four pointed spokes enclosing a stylised letter Y with a disc
